result.brief: 分析低比特量化世界模型（TD-MPC2、DINO-WM）中舍入误差在规划迭代间的持续性与共享性，提出共享抖动策略以恢复规划性能并加速推理。
result.reason: Studies low-bit quantization of learned world models (TD-MPC2, DINO-WM) used inside planners, analyzing how rounding error affects planning; contributes to world-model efficiency and representation fidelity.
